description: Use for a one-line 'accumulating or distributing?' verdict on one ticker: latest-vs-prior-quarter 13F accumulation x insider Form 4 net buying x buy-cluster confirmation, fused on the ticker's reference 13F quarter. Returns a `verdict` (confluence_accumulation / confluence_distribution / partial_net_adding / partial_net_reducing / neutral, or insufficient_13f_coverage / insufficient_history, never coerced to neutral), plus `institutional`, `insider`, `cluster`, `coverage` and a one-line `summary`. A DERIVED verdict, not raw data: no per-fund rows. Per-fund rows: ol_ownership_changes (a ~4-quarter window, so its counts differ). Source: SEC EDGAR 13F-HR + Form 4 (Oxford Ledge derived fusion).
name: ol_institutional_confluence
title: Institutional Confluence
